equipmentCatalog.name: Precision Row-Crop Planter (70 cm / 30 in)
equipmentCatalog.nameRo: Semănătoare de precizie pentru prășitoare (SPC / 70 cm)
equipmentCatalog.description: Required for wide-row precision seeding of maize, sunflower, sorghum, and row-planted soybean.

equipmentCatalog.name: Small-Grain / No-Till Seed Drill (12.5–17 cm)
equipmentCatalog.nameRo: Semănătoare în rânduri dese pentru păioase (SUP)
equipmentCatalog.description: Required for winter wheat, barley, field pea, proso millet, and rye cover crops.

equipmentCatalog.name: Combine Corn Header (snapping rolls)
equipmentCatalog.nameRo: Echipament (heder) de recoltat porumb cu tocător
equipmentCatalog.description: Required to harvest grain maize cleanly without high ear losses.

equipmentCatalog.name: Sunflower Header / Pans Attachment
equipmentCatalog.description: Required to harvest sunflower without losing 15–25% of shattered heads.

equipmentCatalog.name: Center-Pivot / Drum-Reel Irrigation System
equipmentCatalog.description: Optional water-supply lever; unlocks water-intensive rotations under warming scenarios.

maize.notes: Requires precision row planter and combine corn header.

soybean.notes: Can be seeded with either a row planter or a grain drill; harvested with standard grain flex header.

wheat.notes: Winter wheat seeded in autumn with a grain drill; harvested in early summer with standard grain header.

barley.notes: Seeded with grain drill; harvested 10–14 days earlier than winter wheat with standard grain header.

sorghum.notes: Planted with row planter (with sorghum plates) or grain drill; harvested with standard grain header (no special header needed!).

sunflower.notes: Requires row planter and sunflower header/trays to prevent head drop losses.

pea.notes: Seeded early spring with grain drill; harvested with standard grain header.

millet.notes: Short-season drought emergency crop seeded with grain drill; harvested with standard grain header.

fallow.notes: Chemical or light-tillage fallow to store moisture in dryland rotations.

rye_cover.notes: Autumn-seeded winter rye cover crop terminated before spring cash crop.
